# routeros_openflow_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_openflow_port" "port" {
  interface = "ether1"
  switch    = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.
- `switch` (String) Name of the OpenFlow switch instance from `/openflow` that will be able to control the port.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `port_id` (Number) Port ID used to identify the interface in the OpenFlow flow rules.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/openflow/port get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_openflow_port.port "*1"
```
